ms.promise:
・Published 8 Vietnamese news videos about events and data related to Cardano.
・The newsletter's duration is about 3 minutes, presenting news content provided to the Vietnamese community.
ms.criteria:
・The video in the form of a newsletter is moderated by our project advisor and the newsletter is published on YouTube in a journalistic style, the video will be short, concise, easy to understand and viewer friendly.
・Each published video achieves over 300 views after 10 days of posting the video.
・02 videos are posted during the week, production time is every Monday to Friday.
ms.report:
We have completed 8 news videos early for milestone number 1, because the amount of news in August is quite a lot, so we want to bring news soon to the Cardano Vietnam community. 
1. Video Upload link can be viewed here: [CaFi] Cardano news - Vietnamese version - YouTube
2. A summary report of published videos and information on achievements can be viewed here: Report ID_1200004 - Google Trang tính
3. Demonstrative snapshots showing video length and number of views, you can see here: Photo evidence - Google Trang trình bày
